# Formula Calculator

> Calculate theoretical nutrient and ingredient composition from a reviewed batch formula. Trace sources, missing data, and assumptions before using a result.

<!-- Keep in sync with robots.txt and ai.txt. -->

## Public pages

- [Turn a formula into a printable label](https://formula.significanthobbies.com/index.md): Calculate theoretical nutrient and ingredient composition from a reviewed batch formula. Trace sources, missing data, and assumptions before using a result.
- [How our results compare](https://formula.significanthobbies.com/case-studies.md): See how the formula calculator compares with published food and medicine values.

## Notes for agents

Missing nutrient data is never treated as zero; calculations preserve source values and provenance.
